Minimap

Use the minimap to orient yourself and choose a route.

Zoom changes the visible area. Map symbols mark known units, objectives and exits.

Controls depend on your keyboard, gamepad and camera settings. The in-game guide shows your current bindings.

Classic edition reference

These original pages describe classic mouse and keyboard controls. Use the guidance above for current settings and gamepad controls.

General information

The Mini-map (shown here in a highlighted frame) provides a quick overview of the Game zone. You can use it to see your character's current location. The Mini-map always shows the entire Game zone, regardless of how much terrain you've managed to explore.

Different colored triangles indicate your character(s) and all those they might come into contact with.

Green triangles represent your characters
Yellow triangles represent neutral characters
Red triangles represent enemies.

Features

To control the Mini-map use the buttons to the right (they're framed). You can zoom in and out or set the camera to a default direction.

To zoom in/out use the <+>/<-> keys
To set the camera facing North use the <N> key or the "N" button.
To show/hide the Mini-map use the framed upper-right button or the <M> key.

Note: When the camera is set to "North", the terrain's orientation on the game screen is the same as in the Mini-map.

Example

You now need to move to the bridge which crosses the river in the center of the Game zone. Click on the area in the Mini-map and the camera will move to that point, providing you with useful scouting information.
If you want to point the camera back on your character, just double-click on his picture.
